traefik.enable=true
traefik.docker.network=proxy
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-web.rule=Host(`example.com`)
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-web.entrypoints=websecure
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-web.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-web.priority=1
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-web.service=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-web
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-web.middlewares=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-hsts
traefik.http.services.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-web.loadbalancer.server.port=3000
traefik.http.middlewares.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-hsts.headers.stsSeconds=31536000
